title: Studiegids — Study Guide / Systems Security
paragraphs:
The
 course overviews principles, concepts, methods, and best practices in 
computer systems security. The students will obtain the necessary 
background and hands-on experience to design secure computer systems, 
study attacks and defense methods in computer systems, develop and test 
code to explore vulnerabilities, and apply practical defenses against 
software and hardware attacks. Topics covered in the course include:
At the end of this course, the student is able to:
Study security architecture of computer systems.
Analyse security issues of a specific operating system.
Develop skills in exploiting vulnerabilities of computer systems.
Develop counter measures against exploitation of computer systems.
The final grade of the course consists of the following components:
Group Assignment 1: Lab assignment on code scanning (weighting 10%)
Group Assignment 2: Lab assignment on Finding Gadgets (weighting 10%)
Group Assignment 3: Lab assignment on Systems Call Interposition (weighting 10%)
Group Project: research project in systems security (weighting 20%)

Final
 grade calculation = 0.5 Written Exam + 0.1 * Group Assignment 1 + 0.1 *
 Group Assignment 2 + 0.1 * Group Assignment 3 + 0.2 * Group project

A
 passing final grade for the course can only be earned when for all 
components at least a 5.0 is earned, and the weighted final grade is at 
least a 5.8.
